15005.meaning1: inspired saying; exclamation; one of the nine kinds of suttas

examples.text: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo anupubbena nāḷik'odanaparamatāya saṇṭhāsi. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aparena samayena susallikhitagatto pāṇinā gattāni anumajjanto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
idha, bhikkhave, ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

evam'pi aṭṭhahi kāraṇehi bhagavā tathāgato'ti ayam'ettha saṅkhepo. vitthāro pana paramatthadīpaniyā udān'aṭṭhakathāya (udā. aṭṭha. 18) itivuttak'aṭṭhakathāya (itivu. aṭṭha. 38) ca vuttanayen'eva veditabbo.

15009.meaning2: utters an udāna; makes a joyful utterance

15011.meaning2: by means of an inspired saying

15012.meaning1: uttered an exclamation; expressed a sentiment
15012.commentary: (MNa) udānaṃ udānesī'ti udāhāraṃ udāhari. yathā hi yaṃ telaṃ mānaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, vissanditvā gacchati, taṃ avaseko'ti vuccati, yañ'ca jalaṃ taḷākaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, ajjhottharitvā gacchati, taṃ ogho'ti vuccati. evam'eva yaṃ pītimayaṃ vacanaṃ hadayaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, adhikaṃ hutvā anto asaṇṭhahitvā bahi nikkhamati, taṃ udānan'ti vuccati. evarūpaṃ pītimayaṃ vacanaṃ nicchāresī'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo sabbasetā vaḷavābhirathā orohitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi, namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi, passa samādhiṃ subhāvitaṃ cittañ'ca suvimuttaṃ, na c'ābhinataṃ na c'āpanataṃ na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagataṃ.
evaṃ vutte brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udāneti
atha kho bhagavā etam'atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo anupubbena nāḷik'odanaparamatāya saṇṭhāsi. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aparena samayena susallikhitagatto pāṇinā gattāni anumajjanto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi

15016.meaning1: name of a prince; Ajātasattu's son
15016.meaning2: name of a prince; Ajātasattu's son

examples.text: iminā me upasamena udāyibhaddo kumāro samannāgato hotu, yen'eta'r'ahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato'ti. agamā kho tvaṃ, mahārāja, yathāpeman'ti.

15018.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

15019.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk among those who inspire faith in families; Kāḷudāyī

examples.text: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, hatthim'eva nu kho, bhante, mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāy'upapannaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, nāgo vata, bho, nāgo'ti
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kulappasādakānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷ'udāyī.
atha kho pañcak'aṅgo thapati yen'āyasmā udāyī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

15026.commentary: (VISMa) na hi sabbaso suññatāya diṭṭhāya bhayanandīnaṃ avasaro atthi, atha kho upekkhā'va saṇṭhāti. ten'āha saṅkhāresu udāsīno hotī'ti. tattha yena micchāgāhena anudāsīnatā siyā, tadabhāvaṃ dassento ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā na gaṇhātī'ti āha. (APt) dūramaṇḍale āsatī'ti udāsīno, upubbo āsa upasevane, yu, assi, dāgamo ca.

examples.text: evaṃ suññato disvā tilakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā saṅkhāre pariggaṇhanto bhayañ'ca nandiñ'ca vippahāya saṅkhāresu udāsīno ahosi majjhatto, ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā na gaṇhāti vissaṭṭhabhariyo viya puriso.

15031.meaning1: utterance of the example; sound of the quotation

examples.text: tathā hi ayam'āyasmā na c'eva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakk'āvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.
api ca me, bhante, ahosi kācideva assāsamattā, na tāva bhagavā parinibbāyissati, na yāva bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñci'd'eva udāharatī'ti.

15035.commentary: (MNt) udāharīyati ubbegapītivasenā'ti, tathā vā udāharaṇaṃ udānaṃ. ten'āha udāhāraṃ udāharī'ti.

examples.text: udānaṃ udānesī'ti udāhāraṃ udāhari. yathā hi yaṃ telaṃ mānaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, vissanditvā gacchati, taṃ avaseko'ti vuccati, yañ'ca jalaṃ taḷākaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, ajjhottharitvā gacchati, taṃ ogho'ti vuccati.

15036.meaning1: should be brought up; should be quoted; should be cited

15038.commentary: (MNt) udāharīyati ubbegapītivasenā'ti, tathā vā udāharaṇaṃ udānaṃ. ten'āha udāhāraṃ udāharī'ti.

examples.text: udānaṃ udānesī'ti udāhāraṃ udāhari. yathā hi yaṃ telaṃ mānaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, vissanditvā gacchati, taṃ avaseko'ti vuccati, yañ'ca jalaṃ taḷākaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, ajjhottharitvā gacchati, taṃ ogho'ti vuccati.
kacci te, bhante, bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu udāhu sant'etth'ekacce bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsū'ti?
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
kiṃ te idha sārasammataṃ, kuṇapapūramhi susānavaḍḍhane, bhedanadhamme kaḷevare, yaṃ disvā vimano udikkhasi.

15041.commentary: (THa) gacchanto naṃ udikkhisan'ti nagaravīthiyaṃ gacchanto parissayapariharaṇatthaṃ vīthiṃ olokento taṃ naṭṭakiṃ olokesiṃ.

examples.text: piṇḍikāya paviṭṭho'haṃ, gacchanto naṃ udikkhisaṃ, alaṅ'kataṃ suvasanaṃ, maccupāsaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ.

15043.meaning1: who looks at; who looks upon; observer; beholder
15043.meaning2: who looks at; who looks upon

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno na ca visaṭaṃ, na ca visāci, na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā, ujuṃ tathā pasaṭam'ujumano, piyacakkhunā bahujanaṃ udikkhitā ahosi.

15045.grammar: aor 1st sg of udikkhi, irreg form of udikkhiṃ, trans (+acc)
15045.commentary: (THa) gacchanto naṃ udikkhisan'ti nagaravīthiyaṃ gacchanto parissayapariharaṇatthaṃ vīthiṃ olokento taṃ naṭṭakiṃ olokesiṃ.

examples.text: piṇḍikāya paviṭṭho'haṃ, gacchanto naṃ udikkhisaṃ, alaṅ'kataṃ suvasanaṃ, maccupāsaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ.

15046.commentary: (THa) udicco ubhato'ti mātito ca pitito ca ubhato udito saṃsuddhagahaṇiko.

examples.text: brahmajacco pure āsiṃ, udicco ubhato ahu, sojja putto sugatassa, dhammarājassa satthuno.

15048.synonym: utta, udīrita, pabhāvita, pavutta, bhaṭṭha, bhaṇita, bhāsita, lapita, vutta, samudāciṇṇa

examples.text: akakkasaṃ viññāpaniṃ, giraṃ saccam'udīraye, yāya n'ābhisaje kañci, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

15051.commentary: (SNa) paṭibhānaṃ udīrayī'ti samuddato ūmiyo viya anantaṃ paṭibhānaṃ uṭṭhahati.

examples.text: saṃkhittena'pi deseti, vitthārena'pi bhāsati, sāḷikāy'iva nigghoso, paṭibhānaṃ udīrayi.

15052.synonym: utta, kathita, pabhāvita, pavutta, bhaṭṭha, bhaṇita, bhāsita, lapita, vutta, samudāciṇṇa

examples.text: tathāgataṃ buddham'asayhasāhinaṃ, duve vitakkā samudācaranti naṃ, khemo vitakko paṭhamo udīrito, tato viveko dutiyo pakāsito.
khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito, dakassa majjhe jalate ghat'āsano, na ajja vāso mahiyā mahīruhe, disā bhajavho saraṇ'ājja no bhayan'ti.
saṃkhittena'pi deseti, vitthārena'pi bhāsati, sāḷikāy'iva nigghoso, paṭibhānaṃ udīriyati.

15056.commentary: (THIa) idāni tāni sarūpato dassentī udukkhalena musalena, patinā khujjakena cā'ti āha. udukkhale hi dhaññaṃ pakkhipantiyā parivattentiyā musalena koṭṭentiyā ca piṭṭhi onāmetabbā hotī'ti khujjakaraṇahetutāya tadubhayaṃ khujjan'ti vuttaṃ. sāmiko pan'assā khujjo eva. idāni yassā muttiyā nidassanavasena tīhi khujjehi mutti vuttā.

examples.text: sumuttā sādhumutt'āmhi, tīhi khujjehi muttiyā, udukkhalena musalena, patinā khujjakena ca, mutt'āmhi jātimaraṇā, bhavanetti samūhatā'ti.

araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesi, tidhā phālesi, catudhā phālesi, pañcadhā phālesi, dasadhā phālesi, satadhā phālesi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesi, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuni, app'eva nāma aggiṃ adhigaccheyyan'ti.

15058.meaning1: something part and parcel of a mortar

15059.commentary: (VINa) evaṃ paribhuñjanto ca ekadivasaṃ assosi kho bhagavā udukkhalasaddan'ti bhagavā patthapatthapulakaṃ koṭṭentānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ musalasaṅghaṭṭajanitaṃ udukkhalasaddaṃ suṇi.

15061.commentary: (SNa) udujitan'ti tajjitaṃ. sudujitan'ti sutajjitaṃ, sujitan'ti'pi attho. udu, sudū'ti idaṃ pana nipātamattam'eva. (SNt) sudujitan'ti nibbisevanabhāvakaraṇena jitaṃ. sutajjitan'ti suṭṭhu dūrakaraṇena jitaṃ, tathābhūtañ'ca tajjitaṃ nāma hotī'ti tathā vuttaṃ. (PMa) uparibhāvāya jitaṃ, uparibhāvakarehi vā ñāṇehi jitaṃ udujitaṃ. samudujitan'ti samā uparibhāvāya, uparibhāvakarehi vā ñāṇehi jitaṃ.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phass'āyatanesu cittaṃ udujitaṃ hoti sudujitaṃ, ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.

15062.notes: Flower of the plant are sheathed within the fruits and these are not visible directly.

examples.text: yo n'ājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ puppham'iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
khandhabījaṃ nāma, assattho, nigrodho, pilakkho, udumbaro, kacchako, kapitthano, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi khandhe jāyanti, khandhe sañjāyanti, etaṃ khandhabījaṃ nāma.

15063.meaning1: cluster fig log; cluster fig tree timber

examples.text: ath'āparo puriso sukkhaṃ ambakaṭṭhaṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyya, ath'āparo puriso sukkhaṃ udumbarakaṭṭhaṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyya.

15064.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of udumbarakhādikā
15064.notes: See SCPN §52 acc. as adv. of manner.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ kulaputto app'āyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro, udumbarakhādikaṃ v'āyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatī'ti.

15068.meaning1: walking stick made of wood from the cluster fig tree
15068.commentary: (SNa) udumbaradaṇḍan'ti appicchabhāvappakāsan'atthaṃ īsakaṃ vaṅkaṃ udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā. (SNt) udumbaradaṇḍañ'hi attagutt'atthāya gahitaṃ tesaṃ appicchabhāvappakāsanaṃ. ten'āha appicchabhāvappakāsan'atthan'ti.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantena jaṭ'aṇḍuvena ajinakkhipanivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghurughurupassāsī udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena te bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca

15070.meaning1: name of a queen who built a park for wandering ascetics

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā udumbarikāya paribbājak'ārāme sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā gijjhakūṭe pabbate paccupaṭṭhāsi. sandhāno pana gahapati tāva'd'eva rājagahaṃ pāvisī'ti.

15072.synonym: pabbati, pavaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍheti, vaddhati, viruhati, virūhati

examples.text: nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā udeno āyasmantaṃ piṇḍolabhāradvājaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bho bhāradvāja, hetu ko paccayo yen'ime daharā bhikkhū susū kāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañ'ca āpādentī'ti?

tatiyam'pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, ramaṇīyā, ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ satt'ambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sāran'dadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
nivesanaṃ ek'ūpacāraṃ nān'ūpacāraṃ. udosito ek'ūpacāro nān'ūpacāro. aṭṭo ek'ūpacāro nān'ūpacāro.
dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado'va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado.

magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.

15087.meaning2: should be visited; should be shown (oneself); lit. to be caused to see
15087.meaningLit: to cause to be looked up
15087.commentary: (MNa) uddassetabbā'ti uddhaṃ dassetabbā, yathā taṃ kālena kālaṃ passanti, evaṃ āgantvā attānaṃ dassetabbā.

examples.text: pabbajitena ca pana te mātāpitaro uddassetabbā'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, mātāpitaro uddassetuṃ, sace maṃ bhagavā anujānātī'ti.
tass'uddānaṃ moḷiyaphaggun'ariṭṭhañ'ca nāmo, andhavane kathipuṇṇaṃ nivāpo, rāsi-kaṇeru-mahāgajanāmo, sār'ūpamo puna piṅgalakoccho.

15093.commentary: (VINt) uddānagāthā'ti uddesagāthā, saṅgahagāthā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (VMVt) taṃ taṃ vatthuṃ uddharitvā dānato dassanato uddānabhūtā gāthā uddānagāthā, saṅgahagāthā, uddesagāthā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: [imā uddānagāthāyo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu na dissanti]
